# local 0015: Since r17205, the install rule of device/lib does not copy the mcs51 libraries for --stack-auto

- Category: [Problems without a ticket and without a patch](../../unreported.md)
- Evidence: tested on r17228
- Recommended action: Iterate over ALLPORTS in install and installdirs of device/lib/Makefile.in, or move the stack-auto names to RELPORTS.
<!-- end of generated block -->

## Finding

On r17228, the rules `installdirs` and `install` of `device/lib/Makefile.in` do not copy
`mcs51-small-stack-auto` and `mcs51-large-stack-auto` to `share/sdcc/lib`. `make` creates both in
`device/lib/build` by default, and sdcc searches them for the libraries when `--stack-auto` is
given with the small or the large model.

The commands below run the recipes of the two rules from `device/lib/Makefile`. `S` is the source
tree of r17228, `B` is its build tree after `make`, configured with only the ports mcs51, stm8,
and z80, and `I` is an empty directory. `bug.c` is the sample program of bug #4252, a `main` that
returns a global `int` divided by 3.

```sh
{
  printf '%s\n' "srcdir = $S/device/lib" "BUILDDIR = $B/device/lib/build" 'CP_U = cp -u' \
    "sdcc_libdir = $I/share/sdcc/lib" 'include $(srcdir)/ports.mk' '.PHONY: install installdirs'
  sed -n '/^install: all installdirs/,/^# Deleting all/p' "$B/device/lib/Makefile" \
    | sed -e 's/^install: all installdirs/install: installdirs/'
  sed -n '/^installdirs:/,/^# Creating dependencies/p' "$B/device/lib/Makefile"
} > inst.mk
make -f inst.mk install
ls "$B/device/lib/build" "$I/share/sdcc/lib"
SDCC_HOME=$I "$B/bin/sdcc" -mmcs51 --model-large --stack-auto bug.c
```

`make` exits with status 0. Of the six mcs51 directories in `device/lib/build`, `share/sdcc/lib`
has `mcs51-small`, `mcs51-medium`, `mcs51-large`, and `mcs51-huge`. With
`--model-large --stack-auto` and with `--model-small --stack-auto`, the linker reports
`Couldn't find library` for `libsdcc`, `libsdccf`, `libc`, and `libm`, and sdcc exits with status
1. The program links without a model option, with `--model-medium`, and with `--model-large`.

A top-level `make install` was not run on r17228. The commands leave out the prerequisite `all`
and the top-level makefile, whose `install` rule runs `make -C device/lib install`.

## Cause

Since [r17205](https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/code/17205/), a change for bug #4252, the loops of
`installdirs` and `install` iterate over `RELPORTS` in `device/lib/ports.mk`. r17222, the fix for
bug #4259, kept that list. `mcs51-small-stack-auto`, `mcs51-small-xstack-auto`, and
`mcs51-large-stack-auto` are in `ALLPORTS` and not in `RELPORTS`. `TARGETS` in
`device/lib/Makefile.in` has the targets of the two stack-auto directories, and `get_model` in
`src/mcs51/main.c` returns their names for `--stack-auto`. Before r17205, `install` copied
`$(BUILDDIR)/*`. On r17200, whose `device/lib/Makefile.in` and `ports.mk` are identical to those
of r17204, a top-level `make install` with `DESTDIR` installed both directories.

## Open

A patch is not offered. Two changes are possible, and neither was run.

- Iterate over `ALLPORTS` in both loops. The loops copy a directory only when it is in
  `$(BUILDDIR)`, and `mcs51-small-xstack-auto` is not in `TARGETS`.
- Move the stack-auto names from the list of `ALLPORTS` to `RELPORTS`. The two loops and the
  definition of `ALLPORTS` are the only places that use `RELPORTS`.

With either change, `install` also copies the stack-auto source directories to `lib/src`, which
the rule before r17205 did not copy. Both changes also make the rules copy `mos6502-stack-auto`,
`mos65c02-stack-auto`, `pdk15-stack-auto`, and `s08-stack-auto`. These four are in `ALLPORTS` and
not in `RELPORTS`, `TARGETS` has a target for each, and their ports were not built.
`support/scripts/sdcc.nsi` has sections for the two mcs51 stack-auto directories, and r17205 gave
their paths the prefix `mcs51-`. The Windows installer was not built.
